name: Carousel Wall Scroll
description: A three.js scroll scene for React: a tilted carousel of image fins spins up as you scroll, then card by card the images slide off and fly onto a tilted wall while the camera zooms in, and the wall settles into a panel beside your content. Pinned and scrubbed by scroll, one instanced draw call.

props.name: images
props.description: Image URLs (remote hosts need CORS). They repeat around the carousel and across the wall.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Card width / height (images are cover-cropped to it).

props.name: aside
props.description: Content that arrives beside the wall at the end.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height (h-svh for a hero).
